sources.source_name: Microsoft: fourth-quarter and full-year fiscal 2013 results
sources.notes: Fiscal 2013 revenue was $77.85 billion and operating income $26.76 billion. Enterprise software growth contrasted with weak consumer PCs and a $900 million Surface RT inventory charge.
Net income fell 57% to $19.28 billion in 2009. Lower commodity prices, weaker margins and demand hurt results; the annual dividend per share increased 7%.

Quarterly profit was $6.86 billion. The company bought $4 billion of shares to reduce shares outstanding. The reported 57% profit decline largely reflected prior-year divestment and tax gains, so it is not presented as a 57% operating collapse.
